english.note: Use 慳 when efficient means economical with a specified resource, especially electricity, fuel, time, or effort.

exampleSentences.english: This air conditioner is very efficient and saves a lot on the electricity bill each month.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢部冷氣機幾慳電，一個月慳到好多電費。
